subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) At the age of eleven he showed his poetic genius. (b) His famous poem 'Bidrohi' stirred the whole nation. (c) Our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born is 1306 B.S (1899 A.D.) at Churulia in the district of Burdwan. (d) In 1914 when the First World War broke out, he wanted to join the army. (e) In 1972, he was brought to Bangladesh from Kolkata and was declared our national poet. (f) His poem inspired our freedom fighters in the liberation war of Bangladesh. (g) On his return from the battle field, he gave up the sword for the pen and began to write poems. (h) At last at the age of 19 he joined the army as an ordinary soldiers. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)

question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to

(c) The Queen of Sheba heard about the name and fame of King Solomon. (d) Many many years ago there lived a king named Solomon. (e) She also brought with her some artificial flowers. (f) She could not believe that he was so wise and wealthy. (g) The Queen brought with her hundreds of servants carrying many presents. (h) She decided to visit the country and meet the King personally. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
